speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any mucus? If so, what color is the mucus and how much do you cough up? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; the hyperinflation and flattened diaphragm suggest air trapping. Have you noticed if your cough worsens after eating, or do you experience any food coming back up into your throat or chest? REQUEST TEST: Barium_Swallow

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal swallow study and lung hyperinflation, have you been experiencing difficulty exhaling fully or feeling short of breath even when resting? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry confirms an obstructive pattern consistent with COPD. Have you ever smoked, or have you been regularly exposed to dust or chemical fumes in your work environment? Have you noticed any swelling in your ankles or rapid weight gain recently? REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely emphysema predominant given the hyperinflation and normal ABG.
